fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the use of a Microsoft signed script 'REGISTER_APP.VBS' to register a VSS/VDS Provider as a COM+ application.
fields.name: REGISTER_APP.VBS Proxy Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\register_app.vbs" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-register"))
